high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "wintourworld." The post features a photograph of Anna Wintour, the editor-in-chief of Vogue, taken at the 2023 US Open Tennis Tournament in New York City. People: Anna Wintour is the central figure in the image. She is wearing a vibrant floral dress with red, blue, and white flowers on a dark background. The dress has a ruffled hem and puffed sleeves. She is also wearing sunglasses and holding a small white handbag with a gold chain strap.
